design_intent.goal: eliminate visually floating service/support hardware by giving closed supports, safety stays and gas struts explicit fixed cabinet load paths

closed_front_support.rule: closed cradle side rails land on fixed sidewall-supported seats; no floating pad and no play load carried only by pivot or gas springs

safety_stay_fixed_anchor.rule: stay fixed pin/bracket loads into a locally doubled sidewall and captive steel plate; not a screw into single 18 mm plywood

gas_strut_fixed_anchor.final_thread_and_hole_pattern_status: TBD with final gas-spring ball-stud bracket after mass/CG solve
gas_strut_fixed_anchor.rule: gas-strut bracket loads into doubled plywood plus captive steel plate; gas struts remain assist-only

closed_latch_receiver.receiver_zone_material: steel bracket/strike on reinforced sidewall support zone
closed_latch_receiver.rule: positive latch receiver is fixed to cabinet structure and captures the cradle in play position without using TV chassis as a stop
